normative_source.paper: Deep Learning-Based Genetic Perturbation Models Do Outperform Uninformative Baselines on Well-Calibrated Metrics

files.use: upstream attribution and redistribution conditions for vendored metric code

semantic_notes.weight_transform: absolute score -> min-max [0,1] -> square -> align genes -> normalize inside metric
semantic_notes.wmse: sum of normalized target-specific weights times squared gene error
semantic_notes.weighted_delta_r2_primary: weighted_r2_deltapert, using deltas from split-specific training-condition mean
semantic_notes.nir: Normalized Inverse Rank; fraction of strict identity-retrieval distance comparisons won within covariate
semantic_notes.drf: candidate-independent positive-vs-negative-control diagnostic; continuous; no universal threshold
semantic_notes.locked_commit_nir_drf_boundary: NIR exists in metrics_engine.py but is absent from the locked commit's METRICS_CONFIG for DRF

provenance_only_source.paper: Diversity by Design: Addressing Mode Collapse Improves scRNA-seq Perturbation Modeling on Well-Calibrated Metrics
provenance_only_source.use: conceptual provenance and regression comparison only; never mixed into the normative implementation

forbidden: using an unfixed branch name such as main
substituting weighted Pearson for weighted delta R2
defining weights as t squared divided by the t-squared sum
calling NIR a top-K DEG inverse-rank score
using a later upstream NIR-DRF implementation in the primary verdict
